title.zh: 卷十七 本紀第十七: 世祖十四
title.raw: 卷十七 本紀第十七: 世祖十四 Volume 17 Annals 17: Shizu 14

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月甲午朔，以日食免朝賀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, on the jiawu new moon, court audience was waived because of a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, in the first month of spring, on the jiawu new moon, court audience was waived because of a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 日食時，左右有珥，上有抱氣。

translations.literal: At the time of the solar eclipse, ears appeared on the left and right, and embracing qi above.
translations.idiomatic: During the eclipse, solar paraselenae appeared to left and right, with a corona above.

sentences.zh: 丙申，雲南行中書省言：「羅甸歸附後改普定府，隸雲南省三十餘年。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "After Luodian submitted, it was changed to Puding Prefecture and for more than thirty years was subordinate to Yunnan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Yunnan branch secretariat said, "After Luodian submitted, it was changed to Puding Prefecture and for more than thirty years was subordinate to Yunnan Province.

sentences.zh: 今創羅甸宣慰安撫司，隸湖南省，不便，乞罷之，仍以其地隸雲南省。

translations.literal: Now the Luodian Pacification and Assuagement Commission has newly been created and subordinated to Hunan Province; this is inconvenient; we request it be abolished, and its territory again be subordinated to Yunnan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Luodian pacification and assuagement commission has newly been created and subordinated to Hunan Province; this is inconvenient; we request it be abolished and its territory again be subordinated to Yunnan Province.

sentences.zh: 」制曰：「可。

translations.literal: " An edict said: "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Approved."

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，清州饑，就陵州發粟四萬七千八百石賑之。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Qing Prefecture suffered famine; grain was issued from Ling Prefecture — forty-seven thousand eight hundred shi — to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Qing Prefecture suffered famine; 47,800 shi of grain was issued from Ling Prefecture to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命太史令郭守敬兼領都水監事，仍置都水監少監、丞、經歷、知事凡八員。

translations.literal: On jihai day Director of the Astronomy Bureau Guo Shoujing was ordered concurrently to superintend the Directorate of Waterways; eight posts were still established — vice director, assistant director, recorder, and clerk.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Director of the Astronomy Bureau Guo Shoujing was ordered concurrently to superintend the directorate of waterways; eight posts were still established — vice director, assistant director, recorder, and clerk.

sentences.zh: 八作司官舊制六員，今分為左右二司，增官二員。

translations.literal: The Eight Crafts Office had formerly had six officials by regulation; now it was divided into left and right offices, with two posts added.
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Crafts Office had formerly had six officials by regulation; now it was divided into left and right offices, with two posts added.

sentences.zh: 庚子，江西行省左丞高興言：「江西、福建汀、漳諸處連年盜起，百姓入山以避，乞降旨招諭復業。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Jiangxi Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Gao Xing said: "In Jiangxi and in Ting and Zhang of Fujian, bandits have risen year after year; the common people have entered the mountains to escape; we request an imperial order to summon and instruct them to return to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jiangxi branch secretariat left vice chancellor Gao Xing said, "In Jiangxi and in Ting and Zhang of Fujian, bandits have risen year after year; the common people have entered the mountains to escape; we request an imperial order to summon and instruct them to return to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 福建鹽課既設運司，又設四鹽使司，今若設提舉司專領鹽課，其酒稅課悉歸有司為便。

translations.literal: Fujian salt revenues have both a transport commission and four salt commissioner's offices; if now a supervisory office is established to oversee salt revenues exclusively, and wine tax revenues are all returned to the regular offices, that would be convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian salt revenues have both a transport commission and four salt commissioner's offices; if now a supervisory office is established to oversee salt revenues exclusively, and wine tax revenues are all returned to the regular offices, that would be convenient.

sentences.zh: 福建銀鐵又各立提舉司，亦為冗濫，請罷去。

translations.literal: Fujian silver and iron likewise each had supervisory offices established — this too is redundant; we request they be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian silver and iron likewise each had supervisory offices established — this too is redundant; we request they be abolished.

sentences.zh: 」詔皆從之。

translations.literal: " An edict approved all of this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved all of this.

sentences.zh: 禁商賈私以金銀航海。

translations.literal: Merchants were forbidden privately to take gold and silver to sea.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants were forbidden privately to take gold and silver to sea.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以武平地震，全免去年稅四千五百三十六錠，今年量輸之，止征二千五百六十九錠。

translations.literal: On renyin day, because of the Wuping earthquake, last year's tax of four thousand five hundred thirty-six ingots was remitted in full; this year a measured levy was collected — only two thousand five hundred sixty-nine ingots were levied.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, because of the Wuping earthquake, last year's tax of 4,536 ingots was remitted in full; this year a measured levy was collected — only 2,569 ingots were levied.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命玉典赤阿裏置司邕州以便糧餉，而以輕軍邏思明州。

translations.literal: On guimao day yuhanchi Arigh was ordered to establish a relay station at Yong Prefecture for the convenience of grain supplies, while light troops were returned to garrison Siming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day yuhanchi Arigh was ordered to establish a relay station at Yong Prefecture for the convenience of grain supplies, while light troops were returned to garrison Siming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以漢天師張宗演男與棣嗣其教。

translations.literal: The Han Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan's son Yudi was made to succeed to his office.
translations.idiomatic: The Han Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan's son Yudi was made to succeed to his office.

sentences.zh: 升利用監正三品。

translations.literal: The director of the Liyong Directorate was promoted to rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the Liyong Directorate was promoted to rank 3a.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔：「江南州縣學田，其歲入聽其自掌，春秋釋奠外，以廩師生及士之無告者。

translations.literal: On jiachen day an edict said: "For school lands of prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, their annual income may be self-administered; aside from the spring and autumn sacrificial offerings, it shall support teachers and students and scholars without means.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict said, "For school lands of prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, their annual income may be self-administered; aside from the spring and autumn sacrificial offerings, it shall support teachers and students and scholars without means.

sentences.zh: 貢士莊田，則令核數入官。

translations.literal: As for lands of examination-candidate estates, the yield shall be verified and submitted to the government.
translations.idiomatic: As for lands of examination-candidate estates, the yield shall be verified and submitted to the government.

sentences.zh: 」乙巳，賜諸王失都兒金千兩。

translations.literal: " On yisi day Prince Shidu'er was granted one thousand taels of gold.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Prince Shidu'er was granted 1,000 taels of gold.

sentences.zh: 丙午，河南、福建行中書省臣請詔用漢語，有旨以蒙古語諭河南，漢語諭福建。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Henan and Fujian branch secretariat officials requested an edict using Chinese; an order directed that Mongolian language instruct Henan and Chinese instruct Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Henan and Fujian branch secretariat officials requested an edict using Chinese; an order directed that Mongolian language instruct Henan and Chinese instruct Fujian.

sentences.zh: 罷河南宣慰司，以汴梁、襄陽、河南、南陽、歸德皆隸河南行省。

translations.literal: The Henan Pacification Commission was abolished; Bianliang, Xiangyang, Henan, Nanyang, and Guide were all subordinated to Henan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan pacification commission was abolished; Bianliang, Xiangyang, Henan, Nanyang, and Guide were all subordinated to Henan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 復割湖廣省之德安、漢陽、信陽隸荊湖北道，蘄黃隸淮西道，並淮東道三宣慰司咸隸河南省。

translations.literal: De'an, Hanyang, and Xinyang of Huguang Province were again cut away and subordinated to Jinghu North Circuit; Qi and Huang to Huai West Circuit; and all three pacification commissions of Huai East Circuit were subordinated to Henan Province.
translations.idiomatic: De'an, Hanyang, and Xinyang of Huguang Province were again cut away and subordinated to Jinghu North Circuit; Qi and Huang to Huai West Circuit; and all three pacification commissions of Huai East Circuit were subordinated to Henan Province.

sentences.zh: 其荊湖北道宣慰司舊領辰、沅、澧、靖、歸、常德，直隸湖廣省。

translations.literal: Its Jinghu North Circuit Pacification Commission had formerly governed Chen, Yuan, Li, Jing, Gui, and Changde; these were directly subordinated to Huguang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Its Jinghu North Circuit pacification commission had formerly governed Chen, Yuan, Li, Jing, Gui, and Changde; these were directly subordinated to Huguang Province.

sentences.zh: 從葛蠻軍民安撫使宋子賢請，詔諭未附平伐、大甕眼、紫江、皮陵、潭溪、九堡等處諸洞貓蠻。

translations.literal: Following the request of Gemman Military-Civil Assuagement Commissioner Song Zixian, an edict instructed the various cave Cat Miao of Pingfa, Dayongyan, Zijiang, Piling, Tanxi, Jiubao, and other unsubmitting places.
translations.idiomatic: Following the request of Gemman military-civil assuagement commissioner Song Zixian, an edict instructed the various cave Cat Miao of Pingfa, Dayongyan, Zijiang, Piling, Tanxi, Jiubao, and other unsubmitting places.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太陰犯歲及軒轅左角。

translations.literal: On wushen day the moon transgressed Jupiter and the left horn of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon transgressed Jupiter and the left horn of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，興州之興安、宜興兩縣饑，賑米五千石。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Xing'an and Yixing, two counties of Xing Prefecture, suffered famine; five thousand shi of rice was issued in relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Xing'an and Yixing, two counties of Xing Prefecture, suffered famine; 5,000 shi of rice was issued in relief.

sentences.zh: 罷南雄、韶州、惠州三路錄事司。

translations.literal: The record-keeping offices of Nanxiong, Shaozhou, and Huizhou circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The record-keeping offices of Nanxiong, Shaozhou, and Huizhou circuits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬子，桓州至赤城站戶告饑，給鈔計口賑之。

translations.literal: On renzi day relay-station households from Huan Prefecture to Chicheng reported famine; notes were issued per person to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day relay-station households from Huan Prefecture to Chicheng reported famine; notes were issued per person to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，罷四賓庫，復會同館，初置織造段匹提舉司五。

translations.literal: On guichou day the Four Guest Storehouses were abolished and the Hall of Joint Audience restored; five supervisory offices for weaving section-cloth were initially established.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Four Guest Storehouses were abolished and the Hall of Joint Audience restored; five supervisory offices for weaving section-cloth were initially established.

sentences.zh: 八番都元帥劉德祿言：「新附洞蠻十五寨，請置官府以統之。

translations.literal: Eight Banners commander-in-chief Liu Delu said: "Fifteen stockades of newly submitted cave Miao — we request government offices be established to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Banners commander-in-chief Liu Delu said, "Fifteen stockades of newly submitted cave Miao — we request government offices be established to govern them.

sentences.zh: 」詔設陳蒙、爛土軍民安撫司。

translations.literal: " An edict established the Chenmeng-Lantu Military-Civil Assuagement Commission.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established the Chenmeng-Lantu military-civil assuagement commission.

sentences.zh: 江西行省伯顏、阿老瓦丁言：「蒙山歲課銀二萬五千兩。

translations.literal: Jiangxi Branch Secretariat officials Bayan and Alawadin said: "Mengshan yields twenty-five thousand taels of silver annually in levies.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi branch secretariat officials Bayan and Alawadin said, "Mengshan yields 25,000 taels of silver annually in levies.

sentences.zh: 初制，煉銀一兩，免役夫田租五斗，今民力日困，每兩擬免一石。

translations.literal: By the original regulation, for each tael of silver refined, five dou of corvée labor and land rent was remitted; now the people's strength grows daily exhausted; for each tael it is proposed to remit one shi.
translations.idiomatic: By the original regulation, for each tael of silver refined, five dou of corvée labor and land rent was remitted; now the people's strength grows daily exhausted; for each tael it is proposed to remit one shi.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「重困吾民，民何以生！

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "You heavily burden my people — how are the people to live!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "You heavily burden my people — how are the people to live!

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，播州洞蠻因籍戶懷疑竄匿，降詔招集之。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the cave Miao of Bozhou, suspecting harm from household registration, fled and hid; an edict was issued summoning and gathering them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the cave Miao of Bozhou, suspecting harm from household registration, fled and hid; an edict was issued summoning and gathering them.

sentences.zh: 以行播州軍民安撫使楊漢英為紹慶珍州南平等處沿邊宣慰使、行播州軍民宣撫使、播州等處管軍萬戶，仍佩虎符。

translations.literal: Acting Bozhou Military-Civil Assuagement Commissioner Yang Hanying was made pacification commissioner of the frontier regions including Shaoqing, Zhen, and Nanping, acting Bozhou military-civil pacification commissioner, and commander of ten thousand households governing troops at Bozhou and other places; he was still granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Bozhou military-civil assuagement commissioner Yang Hanying was made pacification commissioner of the frontier regions including Shaoqing, Zhen, and Nanping, acting Bozhou military-civil pacification commissioner, and commander of ten thousand households governing troops at Bozhou and other places; he was still granted a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，召嗣漢天師張與棣赴闕。

translations.literal: On renxu day the succeeding Han Celestial Master Zhang Yudi was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the succeeding Han Celestial Master Zhang Yudi was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子朔，金竹酋長騷驢貢馬、氈各二十有七，從其請減所部貢馬，降詔招諭之。

translations.literal: Second month, on the jiazi new moon, the Jinzhu chieftain Saolü presented twenty-seven horses and twenty-seven felts each; following his request to reduce tribute horses from his jurisdiction, an edict was issued summoning and instructing him.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on the jiazi new moon, the Jinzhu chieftain Saolü presented 27 horses and 27 felts each; following his request to reduce tribute horses from his jurisdiction, an edict was issued summoning and instructing him.

sentences.zh: 賜新附黑蠻衣襖，遣回，命進所產朱砂、雄黃之精善者，無則止。

translations.literal: Newly submitted Black Miao were granted jackets and sent back; they were ordered to present the finest cinnabar and realgar their land produced — if none, then stop.
translations.idiomatic: Newly submitted Black Miao were granted jackets and sent back; they were ordered to present the finest cinnabar and realgar their land produced — if none, then stop.

sentences.zh: 遣使代祀嶽瀆、后土、四海。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Earth Altar, and Four Seas on the Emperor's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Earth Altar, and Four Seas in the Emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，給輝州龍山、裏州和中等縣饑民糧一月。

translations.literal: On yichou day one month's grain was granted to famine victims of Longshan in Huizhou and Zhonghe and other counties in Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day one month's grain was granted to famine victims of Longshan in Huizhou and Zhonghe and other counties in Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，畋於近郊。

translations.literal: On dingmao day he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 命宿衛受月廩及蒙古軍以艱食受糧者，宣徽院仍領之。

translations.literal: Palace guards receiving monthly rations and Mongol troops receiving grain because of food hardship were ordered still to be overseen by the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: Palace guards receiving monthly rations and Mongol troops receiving grain because of food hardship were ordered still to be overseen by the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太陰犯畢。

translations.literal: On jisi day the moon transgressed Net.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon transgressed Net.

sentences.zh: 發通州、河西務粟，賑東安、固安、薊州、寶坻縣饑民。

translations.literal: Grain from Tong Prefecture and Hexiwu was issued to relieve famine victims of Dong'an, Gu'an, Ji Prefecture, and Baodi County.
translations.idiomatic: Grain from Tong Prefecture and Hexiwu was issued to relieve famine victims of Dong'an, Gu'an, Ji Prefecture, and Baodi County.

sentences.zh: 申禁鞭背。

translations.literal: The lash to the back was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The lash to the back was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 庚午，斡羅思招附桑州生貓、羅甸國古州等峒酋長三十一，所部民十二萬九千三百二十六戶，詣闕貢獻。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Woluosi received the submission of thirty-one cave chieftains including Shengmao of Sang Prefecture and Guzhou of Luodi, comprising one hundred twenty-nine thousand three hundred twenty-six households under their jurisdiction; they came to court bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Woluosi received the submission of 31 cave chieftains including Shengmao of Sang Prefecture and Guzhou of Luodi, comprising 129,326 households under their jurisdiction; they came to court bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬申，敕遣使分行諸路，釋死罪以下輕囚。

translations.literal: On renshen day an order directed envoys dispatched separately to the various circuits to release prisoners below capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day an order directed envoys dispatched separately to the various circuits to release prisoners below capital crimes.

sentences.zh: 澤州獻嘉禾。

translations.literal: Ze Prefecture presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: Ze Prefecture presented auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，立總管高麗女直漢軍萬戶府，頒銀印，總軍六千人。

translations.literal: On yihai day the Ten-thousand-household Office commanding Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han troops was established; a silver seal was issued; it commanded six thousand troops in all.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the ten-thousand-household office commanding Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han troops was established; a silver seal was issued; it commanded 6,000 troops in all.

sentences.zh: 以泉府太卿亦黑迷失、鄧州舊軍萬戶史弼、福建行省右丞高興並為福建行中書省平章政事，將兵征瓜哇，用海船大小五百艘、軍士二萬人。

translations.literal: Quanfu Grand Minister Yiheimishi, former Deng Prefecture commander of ten thousand households Shi Bi, and Fujian Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Gao Xing were all made grand councillors of the Fujian Branch Secretariat, commanding troops on campaign against Java, using five hundred large and small seagoing vessels and twenty thousand soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Quanfu grand minister Yiheimishi, former Deng Prefecture commander of ten thousand households Shi Bi, and Fujian branch secretariat right vice chancellor Gao Xing were all made grand councillors of the Fujian branch secretariat, commanding troops on campaign against Java, using 500 large and small seagoing vessels and 20,000 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立征行左、右軍都元帥府，都元帥四、副都元帥二。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the Left and Right Campaign Armies commander-in-chief headquarters were established — four commanders-in-chief and two vice commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the left and right campaign armies commander-in-chief headquarters were established — four commanders-in-chief and two vice commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 上萬戶府達魯花赤四、萬戶皆四、副萬戶八、鎮撫四，各佩虎符。

translations.literal: Four darughachi of ten-thousand-household offices, four commanders of ten thousand households each, eight vice commanders of ten thousand households, and four pacification commissioners — each bore a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Four darughachi of ten-thousand-household offices, four commanders of ten thousand households each, eight vice commanders of ten thousand households, and four pacification commissioners — each bore a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 詔加高麗王王春太保，仍錫功臣之號。

translations.literal: An edict added Grand Guardian rank to Goryeo King Wang Chun and still bestowed the title of meritorious minister.
translations.idiomatic: An edict added Grand Guardian rank to Goryeo King Wang Chun and still bestowed the title of meritorious minister.

sentences.zh: 詔從諸王阿禿作亂者，朵羅帶以付闊裏吉思，脫叠出以付阿裏，抄兒赤以付月的迷失，合麥以付亦黑迷失，使從軍自效。

translations.literal: An edict directed that among those who followed Prince Atu in rebellion, Duoluodai was given to Kuolijisi, Tiediechu to Arigh, Chaorechi to Yuedimishi, and Hema to Yiheimishi, to serve in the army and redeem themselves.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that among those who followed Prince Atu in rebellion, Duoluodai was given to Kuolijisi, Tiediechu to Arigh, Chaorechi to Yuedimishi, and Hema to Yiheimishi, to serve in the army and redeem themselves.

sentences.zh: 又詔諸王從合丹作亂者，納答兒之鎮南王所，聶怯來之合剌合孫答剌罕所，阿禿之雲南王所，朵列禿之阿裏所，八里帶之月的迷失所，斡裏羅、忽裏帶之東海。

translations.literal: An edict also directed that among those who followed Prince Heda in rebellion: Nadaer to Prince Zhennan's household, Nieqilai to Helahesundarah's household, Atu to the Prince of Yunnan's household, Duaertu to Arigh's household, Balidai to Yuedimishi's household, and Woluoluo and Hulidai to the Eastern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also directed that among those who followed Prince Heda in rebellion: Nadaer to Prince Zhennan's household, Nieqilai to Helahesundarah's household, Atu to the Prince of Yunnan's household, Duaertu to Arigh's household, Balidai to Yuedimishi's household, and Woluoluo and Hulidai to the Eastern Sea.

sentences.zh: 發義倉官倉糧，賑德州、齊河、清平、泰安州饑民。

translations.literal: Grain from charity and government granaries was issued to relieve famine victims of De Prefecture, Qihe, Qingping, and Tai'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Grain from charity and government granaries was issued to relieve famine victims of De Prefecture, Qihe, Qingping, and Tai'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，月兒魯等言：「納速剌丁滅裏、忻都、王巨濟黨比桑哥，恣為不法，楮幣、銓選、鹽課、酒稅，無不更張變亂之。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Yuerlu and others said: "Nasir al-Din Amir, Xindu, and Wang Juji were partisans of Sangge and acted lawlessly without restraint; paper currency, appointments, salt revenues, and wine taxes — nothing was left unchanged and unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Yuerlu and others said, "Nasir al-Din Amir, Xindu, and Wang Juji were partisans of Sangge and acted lawlessly without restraint; paper currency, appointments, salt revenues, and wine taxes — nothing was left unchanged and unsettled.

sentences.zh: 銜命江南理算者，皆嚴急輸期，民至嫁妻賣女，禍及親鄰。

translations.literal: Those charged with auditing accounts in Jiangnan were all pressed with urgent payment deadlines; the people came to selling wives and daughters, and harm reached kin and neighbors.
translations.idiomatic: Those charged with auditing accounts in Jiangnan were all pressed with urgent payment deadlines; the people came to selling wives and daughters, and harm reached kin and neighbors.

sentences.zh: 維楊、錢塘，受害最慘，無故而隕其生五百餘人。

translations.literal: At Weiyang and Qiantang the suffering was most severe; more than five hundred lives were lost without cause.
translations.idiomatic: At Weiyang and Qiantang the suffering was most severe; more than 500 lives were lost without cause.

sentences.zh: 其初士民猶疑事出國家，今乃知天子仁愛元元，而使民至此極者，實桑哥及其凶黨之為，莫不願食其肉。

translations.literal: At first officials and commoners still doubted whether these matters came from the state; now they know the Emperor lovingly cherishes the people — yet that the people were driven to such extremes was truly the doing of Sangge and his vicious faction; none do not wish to eat their flesh.
translations.idiomatic: At first officials and commoners still doubted whether these matters came from the state; now they know the Emperor lovingly cherishes the people — yet that the people were driven to such extremes was truly the doing of Sangge and his vicious faction; none do not wish to eat their flesh.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，此三人既已伏辜，乞依條論坐以謝天下。

translations.literal: We deliberated: these three men have already suffered punishment; we request they be sentenced according to statute to answer to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: We deliberated: these three men have already suffered punishment; we request they be sentenced according to statute to answer to the realm.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 牙亦迷失招無籍民千四百三十六戶，請隸東宮，詔命之耕田。

translations.literal: Yayimishi received one thousand four hundred thirty-six unregistered households and requested they be placed under the Eastern Palace; an edict ordered them to till fields.
translations.idiomatic: Yayimishi received 1,436 unregistered households and requested they be placed under the Eastern Palace; an edict ordered them to till fields.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，從樞密院臣暗伯等請，就襄陽給曲先塔林合剌魯六百三十七戶田器種粟，俾耕而食。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, following the request of Privy Council officials including Anba, at Xiangyang six hundred thirty-seven Qarluq households of Quxiantalin were given farm implements and seed grain to farm and live by their labor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, following the request of privy council officials including Anba, at Xiangyang 637 Qarluq households of Quxiantalin were given farm implements and seed grain to farm and live by their labor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以汪惟和為鞏昌等二十四處便宜都總帥，兼鞏昌府尹，仍佩虎符。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Wang Weihe was made convenient general commander of the twenty-four places including Gongchang, concurrently prefect of Gongchang, and still bore a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Wang Weihe was made convenient general commander of the 24 places including Gongchang, concurrently prefect of Gongchang, and still bore a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 御史臺月兒魯、崔彧等言：「馮子振、劉道元指陳桑哥同列罪惡，詔令省臺臣及董文用、留夢炎等議。

translations.literal: The Censorate — Yuerlu, Cui Yu, and others — said: "Feng Zizhen and Liu Daoyuan pointed out the crimes of Sangge's colleagues; an edict ordered secretariat and censorate officials together with Dong Wenyong, Liu Mengyan, and others to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate — Yuerlu, Cui Yu, and others — said, "Feng Zizhen and Liu Daoyuan pointed out the crimes of Sangge's colleagues; an edict ordered secretariat and censorate officials together with Dong Wenyong, Liu Mengyan, and others to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 其一言：翰林諸臣撰《桑哥輔政碑》者，廉訪使閻復近已免官，余請聖裁。

translations.literal: One matter: among Hanlin officials who compiled the 《Stele of Sangge's Auxiliary Governance》, surveillance commissioner Yan Fu has recently been dismissed from office; as for the rest, we request the sage decision.
translations.idiomatic: One matter: among Hanlin officials who compiled the 《Stele of Sangge's Auxiliary Governance》, surveillance commissioner Yan Fu has recently been dismissed from office; as for the rest, we request the sage decision.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「死者勿論，其存者罰不可恕也。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Let the dead be unmentioned; as for those who live, punishment cannot be forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Let the dead be unmentioned; as for those who live, punishment cannot be forgiven.

sentences.zh: 」乞臺不花等使緬國，詔令遙授左丞。

translations.literal: " Taibuhua and others were requested as envoys to Burma; an edict ordered them remotely conferred as left vice chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: Taibuhua and others were requested as envoys to Burma; an edict ordered them remotely conferred as left vice chancellors.

sentences.zh: 廷議以尚書行使事，其副以郎中處之。

translations.literal: At court it was deliberated that a Minister of Revenue should handle affairs, with his deputy serving as a bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: At court it was deliberated that a minister of revenue should handle affairs, with his deputy serving as a bureau director.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「可。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Approved."

sentences.zh: 」戊子，禁杭州放鷹。

translations.literal: On wuzi day falconry at Hangzhou was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day falconry at Hangzhou was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 己丑，歲星犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On jichou day Jupiter transgressed Xuanyuan's major star.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Jupiter transgressed Xuanyuan's major star.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宣政院臣言，授諸路釋教都總統輦真術納思為太中大夫、土蕃等處宣慰使都元帥。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Xuanzheng Court officials said that Nianzhenshuna, supreme Buddhist president of the various routes, should be conferred Grand Master of Palace Attendance and commander-in-chief pacification commissioner of the Tibetan regions and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Xuanzheng Court officials said that Nianzhenshuna, supreme Buddhist president of the various routes, should be conferred Grand Master of Palace Attendance and commander-in-chief pacification commissioner of the Tibetan regions and other places.

sentences.zh: 敕畸零拔都兒三百四十七戶佃益都閑田，給牛種農具，官為屋居之。

translations.literal: An order directed three hundred forty-seven scattered Badur households to tenant idle fields at Yidu; cattle, seed, and farm implements were granted, and the government built dwellings for them.
translations.idiomatic: An order directed 347 scattered Badur households to tenant idle fields at Yidu; cattle, seed, and farm implements were granted, and the government built dwellings for them.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，山東廉訪司申：「棣州境內春旱且霜，夏復霖澇，饑民啖藜藿木葉，乞賑恤。

translations.literal: On renchen day the Shandong Surveillance Commission reported: "Within De Prefecture, spring brought drought and frost; summer again brought torrential flooding; famine victims ate goosefoot and tree leaves; we request relief.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the Shandong surveillance commission reported, "Within De Prefecture, spring brought drought and frost; summer again brought torrential flooding; famine victims ate goosefoot and tree leaves; we request relief.

sentences.zh: 」敕依東平例，發附近官廩，計口以給。

translations.literal: " An order followed the Dongping precedent, issuing from nearby government granaries according to persons.
translations.idiomatic: An order followed the Dongping precedent, issuing from nearby government granaries according to persons.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，詔遣脫忽思、儂獨赤昔烈門至合敦奴孫界，與駙馬闊裏吉思議行屯田。

translations.literal: Third month, jiawu day: an edict ordered Tuohusi and Nongduchixiliemen dispatched to the Hedunnusun frontier, to consult with imperial son-in-law Kuolijisi on implementing garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiawu day: an edict ordered Tuohusi and Nongduchixiliemen dispatched to the Hedunnusun frontier, to consult with imperial son-in-law Kuolijisi on implementing garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 己亥，樞密院臣言：「出征女直納裏哥，議於合思罕三千新附軍內選撥千人。

translations.literal: On jihai day Privy Council officials said: "For campaigning against Jurchen Nalige, it was deliberated to select one thousand from three thousand newly submitted troops at Hesi Han.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day privy council officials said, "For campaigning against Jurchen Nalige, it was deliberated to select 1,000 from 3,000 newly submitted troops at Hesi Han.

sentences.zh: 」詔先調五百人，行中書省具舟給糧，仍設征東招討司。

translations.literal: " An edict first mobilized five hundred men; the Branch Secretariat was to provide boats and grain; the Eastern Campaign Pacification Commission was still established.
translations.idiomatic: An edict first mobilized 500 men; the branch secretariat was to provide boats and grain; the Eastern Campaign Pacification Commission was still established.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，御史大夫月兒魯等奏：「比監察御史商琥舉昔任詞垣風憲，時望所屬而在外者，如胡祗遹、姚燧、王惲、雷鷹、陳天祥、楊恭懿、高道、程文海、陳儼、趙居信十人，宜召置翰林，備顧問。

translations.literal: On renyin day Censor-in-chief Yuerlu and others memorialized: "Recently surveillance censor Shang Hu recommended men who formerly served in the imperial editorial and censorial bureaus and were trusted by public esteem but are now outside — such as Hu Zhiyuan, Yao Sui, Wang Yun, Lei Ying, Chen Tianxiang, Yang Gongyi, Gao Dao, Cheng Wenhai, Chen Yi, and Zhao Juxin, ten men — who should be summoned and placed in the Hanlin Academy as advisers.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day censor-in-chief Yuerlu and others memorialized, "Recently surveillance censor Shang Hu recommended men who formerly served in the imperial editorial and censorial bureaus and were trusted by public esteem but are now outside — such as Hu Zhiyuan, Yao Sui, Wang Yun, Lei Ying, Chen Tianxiang, Yang Gongyi, Gao Dao, Cheng Wenhai, Chen Yi, and Zhao Juxin, ten men — who should be summoned and placed in the Hanlin Academy as advisers.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「朕未深知，俟召至以聞。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "I do not yet know them well; wait until they are summoned and then report.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "I do not yet know them well; wait until they are summoned and then report.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，中書省臣言：「京畿薦饑，宜免今歲田租。

translations.literal: " On bingwu day central secretariat officials said: "The capital region suffers consecutive famine; this year's land rent should be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day central secretariat officials said, "The capital region suffers consecutive famine; this year's land rent should be remitted.

sentences.zh: 上都、隆興、平灤、河間、保定五路供億視他路為甚，宜免今歲公賦。

translations.literal: Shangdu, Longxing, Pingluan, Hejian, and Baoding — five circuits whose provisioning burdens exceed other circuits — should have this year's public levies remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu, Longxing, Pingluan, Hejian, and Baoding — five circuits whose provisioning burdens exceed other circuits — should have this year's public levies remitted.

sentences.zh: 漢地河泊隸宣徽院，除入太官外，宜弛其禁，便民取食。

translations.literal: River ponds in the Han regions under the Court of Imperial Entertainments — aside from those supplying the Imperial Kitchen — should have their prohibitions relaxed so the people may take food conveniently.
translations.idiomatic: River ponds in the Han regions under the Court of Imperial Entertainments — aside from those supplying the Imperial Kitchen — should have their prohibitions relaxed so the people may take food conveniently.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁未，納速剌丁滅裏以盜取官民鈔一十三萬餘錠，忻都以征理逋負迫殺五百二十人，皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Nasir al-Din Amir, for embezzling more than one hundred thirty thousand ingots of official and private notes, and Xindu, for compelling collection of unpaid debts until five hundred twenty persons were killed — all suffered execution.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Nasir al-Din Amir, for embezzling more than 130,000 ingots of official and private notes, and Xindu, for compelling collection of unpaid debts until 520 persons were killed — all suffered execution.

sentences.zh: 王巨濟雖無贓，帝以與忻都同惡，並誅之。

translations.literal: Wang Juji, though without illicit gains, the Emperor because he shared Xindu's wickedness had him executed as well.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Juji, though without illicit gains, the Emperor because he shared Xindu's wickedness had him executed as well.

sentences.zh: 中書省與御史臺共定贓罪十三等，枉法者五，不枉法者八，罪入死者以聞。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat and Censorate jointly fixed thirteen grades of corruption offenses — five involving perversion of law, eight not involving perversion of law; offenses meriting death were reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: The central secretariat and censorate jointly fixed 13 grades of corruption offenses — five involving perversion of law, eight not involving perversion of law; offenses meriting death were reported upward.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「可。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Approved."

sentences.zh: 」戊申，以威寧、昌等州民饑，給鈔二千錠賑之。

translations.literal: On wushen day, because the people of Weining, Chang, and other prefectures suffered famine, two thousand ingots of notes were issued in relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, because the people of Weining, Chang, and other prefectures suffered famine, 2,000 ingots of notes were issued in relief.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以大司農、同知宣徽院事兼領尚膳監事鐵哥，翰林學士承旨、通政院使兼知尚乘寺事剌真，並為中書平章政事，兼領舊職。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Grand Agriculture Commissioner and Court of Imperial Entertainments deputy commissioner concurrently superintending the Imperial Kitchen Directorate Tiege, and Hanlin Academician Grand Preceptor and Bureau of Transmission commissioner concurrently managing the Imperial Stud Directorate Lazhen, were both made grand councillors of the central secretariat, concurrently retaining their former posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day grand agriculture commissioner and Court of Imperial Entertainments deputy commissioner concurrently superintending the Imperial Kitchen Directorate Tiege, and Hanlin Academician Grand Preceptor and Bureau of Transmission commissioner concurrently managing the Imperial Stud Directorate Lazhen, were both made grand councillors of the central secretariat, concurrently retaining their former posts.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「右丞何榮祖以疾，平章政事麥術丁以久居其任，乞令免署，惟食其祿，與議中書省事。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Right vice chancellor He Rongzu is ill; grand councillor Maishuding has long held his post; we request they be excused from signing documents, receiving only salary, yet deliberating on central secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Right vice chancellor He Rongzu is ill; grand councillor Maishuding has long held his post; we request they be excused from signing documents, receiving only salary, yet deliberating on central secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 以阿裏為中書右丞，梁暗都剌為參知政事。

translations.literal: Arigh was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, and Liang Andula associate administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Arigh was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, and Liang Andula associate administrator.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「亦奚不薛及八番羅甸既各設宣慰司，又復立都元帥府，其地甚狹而官府多，宜合二司帥府為一。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Yixibus and Bafan-Luodian have each had a pacification commission established, yet a commander-in-chief headquarters was also re-established; the territory is very narrow while offices are many; the two commissions and commander headquarters should be merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Yixibus and Bafan-Luodian have each had a pacification commission established, yet a commander-in-chief headquarters was also re-established; the territory is very narrow while offices are many; the two commissions and commander headquarters should be merged into one.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之，且命亦奚不薛與思、播州同隸湖廣省，羅甸還隸雲南，以八番羅甸宣慰使斡羅思等並為八番順元等處宣慰使都元帥，佩虎符。

translations.literal: " An edict approved this, and also ordered Yixibus and Si and Bozhou likewise subordinated to Huguang Province; Luodian restored to Yunnan; Woluosi and others, pacification commissioners of Bafan-Luodian, were all made commanders-in-chief and pacification commissioners of Bafan-Shunyuan and other places, bearing tiger tallies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this, and also ordered Yixibus and Si and Bozhou likewise subordinated to Huguang Province; Luodian restored to Yunnan; Woluosi and others, pacification commissioners of Bafan-Luodian, were all made commanders-in-chief and pacification commissioners of Bafan-Shunyuan and other places, bearing tiger tallies.

sentences.zh: 以安南國王陳益稷遙授湖廣等處行中書省平章政事，佩虎符，居鄂州。

translations.literal: King Chen Yiji of Annam was remotely appointed grand councillor of the Huguang circuit branch secretariat, granted a tiger tally, and resided at Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: King Chen Yiji of Annam was remotely appointed grand councillor of the Huguang circuit branch secretariat, granted a tiger tally, and resided at Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 賜速哥、斡羅思、賽因不花蠻夷之長五十六人金紋綾絹各七十九匹，及弓矢、鞍轡。

translations.literal: Fifty-six tribal chiefs of Sukha, Orus, Sayinbuqa, and others were granted seventy-nine bolts of gold-patterned silk each, as well as bows and arrows, saddles, and bridles.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-six tribal chiefs of Sukha, Orus, Sayinbuqa, and others were granted 79 bolts of gold-patterned silk each, as well as bows and arrows, saddles, and bridles.

sentences.zh: 壬子，樞密院臣奏：「延安、鳳翔、京兆三路籍軍三千人，桑哥皆罷為民，今復其軍籍，屯田六盤。

translations.literal: On renzi day Privy Council officials memorialized: "The three circuits of Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Jingzhao had three thousand registered troops; Sangge had them all dismissed to become commoners; now restore their military registration and garrison-farm at Liupan."
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Privy Council officials memorialized, "The three circuits of Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Jingzhao had 3,000 registered troops; Sangge had them all dismissed to become commoners; now restore their military registration and garrison-farm at Liupan."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 敕都水監分視黃河堤堰，罷河渡司。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Directorate of Waterways to inspect Yellow River dikes and embankments separately, and abolished the River Crossing Office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Directorate of Waterways to inspect Yellow River dikes and embankments separately, and abolished the River Crossing Office.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免寶慶路邵陽縣田租萬三千七百九十三斛。

translations.literal: On gengshen day field rent of thirteen thousand seven hundred ninety-three hu was remitted for Shaoyang County in Baoqing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day field rent of 13,793 hu was remitted for Shaoyang County in Baoqing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，給還楊璉真加土田、人口之隸僧坊者。

translations.literal: On renxu day land, fields, and population that had been attached to monastic quarters under Yang Lianzhenjia were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day land, fields, and population that had been attached to monastic quarters under Yang Lianzhenjia were restored.

sentences.zh: 初，璉真加重賂桑哥，擅發宋諸陵，取其寶玉，凡發冢一百有一所，戕人命四，攘盜詐掠諸贓為鈔十一萬六千二百錠，田二萬三千畝，金銀、珠玉、寶器稱是。

translations.literal: Initially Lianzhenjia gave heavy bribes to Sangge and on his own authority opened the Song imperial tombs, taking their jade and precious objects; in all one hundred one tombs were opened, four lives were taken, and stolen and plundered goods amounted to one hundred sixteen thousand two hundred ingots of notes, twenty-three thousand mu of fields, and corresponding amounts of gold, silver, pearls, jade, and precious vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Lianzhenjia gave heavy bribes to Sangge and on his own authority opened the Song imperial tombs, taking their jade and precious objects; in all 101 tombs were opened, 4 lives were taken, and stolen and plundered goods amounted to 116,200 ingots of notes, 23,000 mu of fields, and corresponding amounts of gold, silver, pearls, jade, and precious vessels.

sentences.zh: 省臺諸臣乞正典刑以示天下，帝猶貸之死，而給還其人口、土田。

translations.literal: Secretariat and censorate officials all requested proper punishment to show the realm; the Emperor still spared his life, but restored his population and land.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat and censorate officials all requested proper punishment to show the realm; the Emperor still spared his life, but restored his population and land.

sentences.zh: 隆興府路饑，給鈔二千錠，復發粟以賑之。

translations.literal: Longxing Prefecture Circuit suffered famine; two thousand ingots of notes were granted, and grain was again issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Longxing Prefecture Circuit suffered famine; 2,000 ingots of notes were granted, and grain was again issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，太陰犯氐。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingzi day the moon encroached upon Di.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on bingzi day the moon encroached upon Di.

sentences.zh: 己卯，復典瑞監三品。

translations.literal: On jimao day the Directorate of Imperial Regalia was restored to rank three.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Directorate of Imperial Regalia was restored to rank three.

sentences.zh: 弛甘肅酒禁，榷其酤。

translations.literal: The Gansu wine prohibition was relaxed, and a monopoly was placed on its sale.
translations.idiomatic: The Gansu wine prohibition was relaxed, and a monopoly was placed on its sale.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，弛太原酒禁，仍榷酤。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the Taiyuan wine prohibition was relaxed, and wine sales were still monopolized.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Taiyuan wine prohibition was relaxed, and wine sales were still monopolized.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，設雲南諸路學校，其教官以蜀士充。

translations.literal: On xinmao day schools were established in the various routes of Yunnan; their instructors were filled from Shu scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day schools were established in the various routes of Yunnan; their instructors were filled from Shu scholars.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，遼陽水達達、女直饑，詔忽都不花趣海運給之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiawu day Liaoyang's Jurchen and Goryeo suffered famine; an edict ordered Hubuduhua to hasten sea transport to supply them.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jiawu day Liaoyang's Jurchen and Goryeo suffered famine; an edict ordered Hubuduhua to hasten sea transport to supply them.

sentences.zh: 丙午，敕：「雲南邊僥入朝，非初附者不聽乘傳，所進馬不給芻豆。

sentences.zh: 使以譽桑哥為罪，則在廷諸臣，誰不譽之！

translations.idiomatic: If praising Sangge is to be a crime, then which court official did not praise him!

sentences.zh: 朕亦嘗譽之矣。

sentences.zh: 」詔以楊居寬、郭佑死非其罪，給還其家資。

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Yang Jukuan and Guo You had died without deserving it; their household property was restored.

sentences.zh: 改思州安撫司為軍民宣撫司，隸湖廣省，詔諭其民因閱戶驚逃者，各使安業。

translations.idiomatic: The Sizhou Pacification Commission was changed to a Military-Civilian Pacification Commission, subordinate to Huguang Province; an edict instructed its people who had fled in alarm during household inspection to each return to secure livelihood.

sentences.zh: 以陜西鹽運司酒稅等課已入州縣，罷諸子鹽司，並罷東平路河道提舉司事入都水監。

translations.idiomatic: Since Shaanxi Salt Transport Commission wine tax and other levies had already entered prefecture and county administration, the various sub-salt offices were abolished, and the Dongping Circuit River Route Intendant Office was also abolished and its affairs transferred to the Directorate of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 己未，龍興路南昌、新建、進賢三縣水，免田租四千四百六十八石。

translations.literal: On jiwei day floods struck Nanchang, Xinjian, and Jinxian three counties in Longxing Circuit; field rent of four thousand four hundred sixty-eight shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day floods struck Nanchang, Xinjian, and Jinxian three counties in Longxing Circuit; field rent of 4,468 shi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 是月，真定之中山新樂、平山、獲鹿、元氏、靈壽，河間之滄州無棣，景之阜城、東光，益都之濰州北海縣，有蟲食桑葉盡，無蠶。

translations.literal: That month, in Zhending's Zhongshan, Xinle, Pingshan, Huolu, Yuanshi, and Lingshou; Hejian's Cangzhou and Wudi; Jing's Fucheng and Dongguang; and Yidu Circuit's Weizhou Beihai County, insects ate mulberry leaves completely and there were no silkworms.
translations.idiomatic: That month, in Zhending's Zhongshan, Xinle, Pingshan, Huolu, Yuanshi, and Lingshou; Hejian's Cangzhou and Wudi; Jing's Fucheng and Dongguang; and Yidu Circuit's Weizhou Beihai County, insects ate mulberry leaves completely and there were no silkworms.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，平江、湖州、常州、鎮江、嘉興、松江、紹興等路水，免至元二十八年田租十八萬四千九百二十八石。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiazi day floods struck Pingjiang, Huzhou, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Shaoxing, and other circuits; Zhiyuan twenty-eighth year field rent of one hundred eighty-four thousand nine hundred twenty-eight shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jiazi day floods struck Pingjiang, Huzhou, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Shaoxing, and other circuits; Zhiyuan 28th year field rent of 184,928 shi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔聽僧食鹽不輸課。

translations.literal: On wuchen day an edict allowed monks to consume salt without paying tax.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict allowed monks to consume salt without paying tax.

sentences.zh: 己巳，日本來互市，風壞三舟，惟一舟達慶元路。

translations.literal: On jisi day Japan came for mutual trade; wind destroyed three boats, and only one boat reached Qingyuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Japan came for mutual trade; wind destroyed 3 boats, and only 1 boat reached Qingyuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 壬申，江西省臣言：「肇慶、德慶二路，封、連二州，宋時隸廣東，今隸廣西，不便，請復隸廣東。

translations.literal: On renshen day Jiangxi Province officials said: "Zhaoqing and Deqing two circuits and Feng and Lian two prefectures were subordinate to Guangdong in Song times but now to Guangxi — this is inconvenient; we request they be restored to Guangdong."
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Jiangxi Province officials said, "Zhaoqing and Deqing two circuits and Feng and Lian two prefectures were subordinate to Guangdong in Song times but now to Guangxi — this is inconvenient; we request they be restored to Guangdong."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 鐵旗城後察昔折乙烈率其族類部曲三千餘戶來附。

translations.literal: Cerechijerili of Tieqicheng's rear guard led more than three thousand households of his clansmen and retainers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Cerechijerili of Tieqicheng's rear guard led more than 3,000 households of his clansmen and retainers to submit.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，設司籍庫，秩從五品，隸太府監，儲物之籍入者。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the Registry Treasury was established, at rank five negative, subordinate to the Directorate of Imperial Treasuries, storing registered incoming goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Registry Treasury was established at rank five negative, subordinate to the Directorate of Imperial Treasuries, storing registered incoming goods.

sentences.zh: 丙子，太寧路惠州連年旱澇，加以役繁，民饑死者五百人，詔給鈔二千錠及糧一月賑之，仍遣使責遼陽省臣阿散。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Huizhou in Daining Circuit had successive years of drought and flood, compounded by heavy corvée; five hundred people died of famine; an edict granted two thousand ingots of notes and one month's grain for relief, and additionally dispatched envoys to reprimand Liaoyang provincial official Asan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Huizhou in Daining Circuit had successive years of drought and flood, compounded by heavy corvée; 500 people died of famine; an edict granted 2,000 ingots of notes and 1 month's grain for relief, and additionally dispatched envoys to reprimand Liaoyang provincial official Asan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，敕以海南新附四州洞寨五百一十九、民二萬餘戶，置會同、定安二縣，隸瓊州，免其田租二年。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered that among the newly submitted Hainan four prefectures, five hundred nineteen cave settlements and more than twenty thousand households, Huitong and Ding'an two counties were established, subordinate to Qiongzhou, and their field rent remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered that among the newly submitted Hainan four prefectures, 519 cave settlements and more than 20,000 households, Huitong and Ding'an two counties were established, subordinate to Qiongzhou, and their field rent remitted for 2 years.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以征瓜哇，暫禁兩浙、廣東、福建商賈航海者，俟舟師已發後，從其便。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, because of the Java campaign, merchants from Two Zhe, Guangdong, and Fujian sailing the seas were temporarily forbidden; after the fleet had sailed they were permitted to proceed as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, because of the Java campaign, merchants from Two Zhe, Guangdong, and Fujian sailing the seas were temporarily forbidden; after the fleet had sailed they were permitted to proceed as convenient.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，湖州、平江、嘉興、鎮江、楊州、寧國、太平七路大水，免田租百二十五萬七千八百八十三石。

translations.literal: On dinghai day great floods struck Huzhou, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Zhenjiang, Yangzhou, Ningguo, and Taiping seven circuits; field rent of one million two hundred fifty-seven thousand eight hundred eighty-three shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day great floods struck Huzhou, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Zhenjiang, Yangzhou, Ningguo, and Taiping seven circuits; field rent of 1,257,883 shi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: On jichou day Venus encroached upon Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Venus encroached upon Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 鐵木塔兒、薛阇禿、捏古帶、闊闊所部民饑，詔給米四千石付鐵木塔兒、薛阇禿，一千石付捏古帶、闊闊，俾以賑之。

translations.literal: The people under Temurtar, Xietu, Negudai, and Kuoku suffered famine; an edict granted four thousand shi of rice to Temurtar and Xietu, and one thousand shi to Negudai and Kuoku, enabling them to relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: The people under Temurtar, Xietu, Negudai, and Kuoku suffered famine; an edict granted 4,000 shi of rice to Temurtar and Xietu, and 1,000 shi to Negudai and Kuoku, enabling them to relieve the people.

sentences.zh: 閏六月辛卯朔，升上都兵馬司四品，如大都。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, on the xinmao new moon, Shangdu's Military Horse Office was promoted to rank four, as in Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary sixth month, on the xinmao new moon, Shangdu's Military Horse Office was promoted to rank four, as in Dadu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遼陽、沈州、廣寧、開元等路雹害稼，免田租七萬七千九百八十八石。

translations.literal: On dingyou day hail damaged crops in Liaoyang, Shenzhou, Guangning, Kaiyuan, and other circuits; field rent of seventy-seven thousand nine hundred eighty-eight shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day hail damaged crops in Liaoyang, Shenzhou, Guangning, Kaiyuan, and other circuits; field rent of 77,988 shi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 岳州華容縣水，免田租四萬九百六十二石。

translations.literal: Floods at Huarong County in Yuezhou; field rent of forty thousand nine hundred sixty-two shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Floods at Huarong County in Yuezhou; field rent of 40,962 shi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 東昌路蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts at Dongchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts at Dongchang Circuit.

translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Dong'an and Haining were transferred to Huai'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 詔大都事繁，課稅改隸轉運司，通州造船畢，罷提舉司。

translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that Dadu's affairs were numerous; tax levies were transferred to the Transport Commission; when Tongzhou shipbuilding was completed, the intendant office was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: Fujian's annual manufacture of ivory belt plaques was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，熒惑犯狗國。

translations.literal: On wushen day Mars encroached upon Dog Country.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Mars encroached upon Dog Country.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，回回人忽不木思售大珠，帝以無用卻之。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the Muslim Hubumusi offered to sell a large pearl; the Emperor, finding it useless, declined.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Muslim Hubumusi offered to sell a large pearl; the Emperor, finding it useless, declined.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，河西務水，給米賑饑民。

translations.literal: On xinhai day floods at Hexiwu; rice was issued to relieve the famine-stricken people.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day floods at Hexiwu; rice was issued to relieve the famine-stricken people.

sentences.zh: 江北河南省既立，詔江北諸城悉隸其省。

translations.idiomatic: Since Henan Province north of the Yangzi had been established, an edict ordered all cities north of the Yangzi subordinate to that province.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Hanyang subordinate to Huguang Province.

translations.literal: Left River route chief controller Huang Jian said: "Within my jurisdiction Huang Shengxu gathered twenty thousand men and occupied Zhongzhou; I request ten thousand troops and three thousand native soldiers be mobilized, with Liu Guojie ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Left River route chief controller Huang Jian said, "Within my jurisdiction Huang Shengxu gathered 20,000 men and occupied Zhongzhou; I request 10,000 troops and 3,000 native soldiers be mobilized, with Liu Guojie ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 臣願調軍民萬人以從。

translations.idiomatic: I am willing to mobilize 10,000 troops and civilians to follow."

translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this.

translations.idiomatic: Goryeo suffered famine; its king sent envoys to request grain; an edict granted 100,000 shi of rice.

translations.literal: On jiayin day Youjiang's Cen Congyi surrendered; Congyi was aged and ill; an edict ordered his son Yourong to inherit, granted a tiger tally, and made him Military-Civilian Chief Controller of Zhen'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Youjiang's Cen Congyi surrendered; Congyi was aged and ill; an edict ordered his son Yourong to inherit, granted a tiger tally, and made him Military-Civilian Chief Controller of Zhen'an Circuit.

translations.idiomatic: Guangnan West Circuit pacification vice commissioner Saipuding and others slandered court policy; Shabuding again funded them; on more than 30 matters heard as rumor they falsely denounced provincial officials; the Emperor, finding this harmful to governance, arrested the evil clique and handed them to officials for punishment according to law.

translations.literal: On yimao day locusts at Jinan and Panyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day locusts at Jinan and Panyang.

translations.literal: That month an edict instructed the surveillance commissions to tour and encourage farming and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict instructed the surveillance commissions to tour and encourage farming and sericulture.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書張立道、郎中歪頭使安南回，以其使臣阮代乏、何維巖至闕。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Zhang Lidao and langzhong Waitou, returning as envoys from Annam, brought their envoys Ruan Daifa and He Weiyan to court.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Zhang Lidao and langzhong Waitou, returning as envoys from Annam, brought their envoys Ruan Daifa and He Weiyan to court.

sentences.zh: 陳日燇拜表箋，修歲貢。

translations.literal: Chen Ridian submitted a memorial and tablet, restoring the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ridian submitted a memorial and tablet, restoring the annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申朔，詔以史弼代也黑迷失、高興，將萬人征瓜哇，仍召三人者至闕。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on the gengshen new moon, an edict ordered Shi Bi to replace Yehheimishi and Gao Xing, leading ten thousand men to campaign against Java, and summoned all three to court.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on the gengshen new moon, an edict ordered Shi Bi to replace Yehheimishi and Gao Xing, leading 10,000 men to campaign against Java, and summoned all three to court.

sentences.zh: 遣使檢核竄名鷹坊受糧者。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to investigate those who falsely registered in the Falconry Office to receive grain rations.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to investigate those who falsely registered in the Falconry Office to receive grain rations.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，河北河南道廉訪司還治汴梁。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the Hebei-Henan Circuit Surveillance Commission returned its administration to Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Hebei-Henan Circuit Surveillance Commission returned its administration to Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，完大都城。

translations.literal: On guihai day the Dadu city wall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Dadu city wall was completed.

sentences.zh: 也裏嵬裏、沙沙嘗簽僧、道、儒、也裏可溫、答赤蠻為軍，詔令止隸軍籍。

translations.literal: Yeliweili and Shasha had once registered monks, Daoists, Confucians, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman as soldiers; an edict ordered this stopped and that only military registration apply.
translations.idiomatic: Yeliweili and Shasha had once registered monks, Daoists, Confucians, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman as soldiers; an edict ordered this stopped and that only military registration apply.

sentences.zh: 甲子，降詔申嚴牛馬踐稼之禁。

translations.literal: On jiazi day a decree was issued strictly enforcing the prohibition against cattle and horses trampling crops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day a decree was issued strictly enforcing the prohibition against cattle and horses trampling crops.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，阿裏願自修船，同張存從征瓜哇軍，往招占城、甘不察，詔授阿裏三珠虎符，張存一珠虎符，仍蠲阿裏父布伯所負斡脫鈔三千錠。

translations.literal: On yichou day Ali wished to repair ships himself and join Zhang Cun with the Java expeditionary army to recruit Champa and Camboja; an edict granted Ali a three-pearl tiger tally and Zhang Cun a one-pearl tiger tally, and additionally remitted three thousand ingots of ortoq notes owed by Ali's father Bober.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Ali wished to repair ships himself and join Zhang Cun with the Java expeditionary army to recruit Champa and Camboja; an edict granted Ali a three-pearl tiger tally and Zhang Cun a one-pearl tiger tally, and additionally remitted 3,000 ingots of ortoq notes owed by Ali's father Bober.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷徽州路錄事司。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the Huizhou Circuit Records Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Huizhou Circuit Records Office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 免屯田租一萬二千八百一十一石。

translations.literal: Garrison-farm rent of twelve thousand eight hundred eleven shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison-farm rent of 12,811 shi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太陰犯牛。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Ox.

sentences.zh: 壬申，建社稷和義門內，壇各方五丈，高五尺，白石為主，飾以五方色土，壇南植松一株，北墉瘞坎壝垣，悉仿古制，別為齋廬，門廡三十三楹。

translations.literal: On renshen day altars to soil and grain were built within the Heyi Gate; each altar was five zhang square and five chi high, with white stone as the spirit tablet, decorated with five-direction colored earth; one pine was planted south of the altar, and north of the wall were buried pits and surrounding walls — all following antique models; separate fast halls and thirty-three bays of gate galleries were also built.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day altars to soil and grain were built within the Heyi Gate; each altar was 5 zhang square and 5 chi high, with white stone as the spirit tablet, decorated with five-direction colored earth; 1 pine was planted south of the altar, and north of the wall were buried pits and surrounding walls — all following antique models; separate fast halls and 33 bays of gate galleries were also built.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，黎兵百戶鄧誌願謀叛，伏誅。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Li corps hundred-household chief Deng Zhiyuan plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Li corps hundred-household chief Deng Zhiyuan plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，敕雲南省擬所轄州縣官如福建、二廣例，省臺委官銓選以姓名聞，隨給授宣敕。

translations.literal: On gengchen day an edict ordered Yunnan Province to propose prefecture and county officials under its jurisdiction following the Fujian and Two Guang precedents; secretariat and censorate officials would conduct selection by name and report, with appointment edicts immediately granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered Yunnan Province to propose prefecture and county officials under its jurisdiction following the Fujian and Two Guang precedents; secretariat and censorate officials would conduct selection by name and report, with appointment edicts immediately granted.

translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on the jichou new moon, Saipuding was executed; his remaining followers were caned and banished, and their household property was registered.

translations.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict ordered that ritual-music households should still pay levies equally with military relay-station and civilian households.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，辰星犯右執法。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Mercury encroached upon Right Executioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Mercury encroached upon Right Executioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白犯房。

translations.literal: On jihai day Venus encroached upon Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Venus encroached upon Fang.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，寧夏府屯田成功，升其官脫兒赤。

translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Ningxia Prefecture garrison-farming succeeded; its official Torechi was promoted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，括唐兀禿魯花所部闊彖赤及河西逃人入蠻地者。

translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Tangut tuqen and their households, and escapees from Hexi who had entered tribal territories, were registered and seized.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 討浙東孟總把等賊，敕諸軍之駐福建者，聽平章政事阇裏節度。

translations.idiomatic: To suppress Zhedong bandit chief Meng Zongba and others, an edict ordered troops stationed in Fujian to obey grand councillor Jelai's command.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，歲星犯右執法。

translations.literal: On yisi day Jupiter encroached upon Right Executioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Jupiter encroached upon Right Executioner.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, following Guo Shoujing's proposal, 14 canal sections from Tongzhou to Dadu were dredged, employing 20,000 soldiers and artisans; 6 canals were also dug to irrigate Changping's waters.

translations.idiomatic: Since the Guangji Office garrison-farms had suffered both locusts and flood, this year's field rent of 9,218 shi was remitted.

translations.idiomatic: Shi Bi was made Fujian branch secretariat grand councillor to command the expeditionary troops.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，高苑縣高希允以非所宜言，伏誅。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Gaoxian's Gao Xiyun was executed for speaking what was inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Gaoxian's Gao Xiyun was executed for speaking what was inappropriate.

translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict ordered Talachi and Cheng Pengfei to suppress Huang Shengxu; Liu Guojie stationed cavalry to garrison and defend.

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Fujian branch secretariat associate administrator Wei Tianyou submitted a plan to mobilize 10,000 civilians to mine mountains and smelt silver, yielding 15,000 liang annually.

sentences.zh: 天祐賦民鈔市銀輸官，而私其一百七十錠，臺臣請追其贓而罷煉銀事，從之。

translations.idiomatic: Tianyou levied notes from the people to buy silver for submission to the government but privately kept 170 ingots; censorate officials requested recovery of the illicit goods and abolition of silver-smelting; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 改燕南河北廉訪司還治真定。

translations.literal: The Yan South-Hebei Surveillance Commission was transferred back to administering from Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan South-Hebei Surveillance Commission was transferred back to administering from Zhending.

sentences.zh: 高麗、女直界首雙城告饑，敕高麗王於海運內以粟賑之。

translations.idiomatic: Shuangcheng at the junction of Goryeo and Jurchen reported famine; an edict ordered the Goryeo king to relieve them with grain from sea transport.

sentences.zh: 弛平灤州酒禁。

translations.literal: The Pingluan wine prohibition was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: The Pingluan wine prohibition was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 詔不敦、忙兀魯迷失以軍征八百媳婦國。

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Budun and Manggulusimi to lead troops to campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives' State.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the censorate and surveillance commission to dispatch officials to investigate.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔諭安南國陳日燇使親入朝。

translations.literal: On xinyou day an edict instructed Chen Rijun of Annam to come to court in person.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict instructed Chen Rijun of Annam to come to court in person.

translations.literal: Liang Ceng, vice pacification commissioner of the Hunan Route, was selected and appointed minister of personnel, wearing a three-pearl tiger tally; Chen Fu, compiler in the Hanlin Imperial History Institute, was appointed bureau director in the Ministry of Rites, wearing a gold tally; together they were sent as envoys to Annam.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Ceng, vice pacification commissioner of the Hunan Route, was selected and appointed minister of personnel with a three-pearl tiger tally; Chen Fu, compiler in the Hanlin Imperial History Institute, was appointed bureau director in the Ministry of Rites with a gold tally; together they were sent as envoys to Annam.

translations.idiomatic: The surveillance commission of Shandong East and West Circuit impeached, "Pacification commissioner Le Shi embezzled 120 ingots from the treasury, purchased 950 taels of treasury silver, had the official workshop privately manufacture saddles, bridles, and other items, and accepted 180 ingots from garrison-farm lands; Le Shi ought to be dismissed from office."

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

translations.literal: On dingmao day central secretariat officials said: "Among the newly submitted cave barbarians of Maoxian, Shiwei, Anhua, and elsewhere there are 80,000 in all; a military-civilian control office should be established, with the native headmen Meng Yi, Meng Shi, and Mo Zhongwen as chief officers and Lü Tianyou and Tabudai as darughachis.

translations.literal: The Eight Banners Uighurs have brought over the Guanglanzhou cave barbarians; Dingyuan Prefecture should be established, and those they recommend—Tugan, Gao Shouwen, Huang Shiceng, and Yanzige—should serve as darughachi, prefect, vice prefect, and assistant prefect.

translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Qianzhou's seat was moved to Duoshui County; Xinde Prefecture was abolished and Tongjiang County established; Mianzhu County in Hanzhou was restored.

translations.literal: People of Shazhou and Guazhou were resettled in Ganzhou; an edict ordered land to be marked out for cultivation on the border between Gan and Su; those without means were granted cattle, implements, and farm tools.
translations.idiomatic: People of Shazhou and Guazhou were resettled in Ganzhou; an edict ordered land marked out for cultivation on the border between Gan and Su, and those without means were granted cattle, implements, and farm tools.

translations.literal: Ningxia had a large population, yet half its fields grew safflower; an edict ordered that all land be planted with grain and wheat to supplement the people's food.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia had a large population, yet half its fields grew safflower; an edict ordered all land planted with grain and wheat to supplement the people's food.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以平灤路大水且霜，免田租二萬四千四十一石。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, because Pingluan Route had suffered both great flood and frost, 24,041 shi of field rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, because Pingluan Route had suffered both great flood and frost, 24,041 shi of field rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Venus transgressed Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Venus transgressed Southern Dipper.

translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan branch censorate was abolished and relocated to Xichuan; a Yunnan surveillance commission was established.

translations.literal: On renwu day Shuodada and Jurchen households driven out from rebel territories were escorted back to their original places and assigned among wanhu, qianhu, and baihu units for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Shuodada and Jurchen households driven out from rebel territories were escorted back to their original places and assigned among wanhu, qianhu, and baihu units for garrison farming.

translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the U-Tsang pacification commission said, "Since Byirigong's rebellion the post stations have been cut off and the people are too poor to supply transport duties."

translations.idiomatic: An order granted U-Tsang's five stations 100 horses, 200 cattle, and 500 sheep each, all paid in silver;

translations.idiomatic: and 736 military households 155 ingots of silver each.

translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, at the Xuanzheng Bureau's request, a branch pacification commission and overall commander were established for the three circuits of U-Tsang, Nari, and Sugursun.

translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on the wuzi new moon, Zhang Shidao, investigative officer of the Fujian surveillance commission, was summoned to court;

translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shidao arrived and requested trimming redundant posts in inner and outer government offices.

sentences.zh: 詔麥術丁、何榮祖、馬紹、燕公楠等與師道同區別之。

translations.idiomatic: Maishuding, He Rongzu, Ma Shao, Yan Gongnan, and others were ordered together with Shidao to sort them out.

sentences.zh: 數月，授師道翰林直學士。

translations.literal: Several months later Shidao was appointed Hanlin direct academician.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later Shidao was appointed Hanlin direct academician.

translations.literal: Japanese ships arrived at Siming seeking mutual trade; armor and weapons were all aboard and there was fear of hostile intent; an edict established a commander-in-chief headquarters and ordered Haladai to lead it to guard the sea route.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese ships arrived at Siming seeking mutual trade; armor and weapons were all aboard and there was fear of hostile intent; an edict established a commander-in-chief headquarters and ordered Haladai to lead it to guard the sea route.

sentences.zh: 詔浚浙西河道，導水入海。

translations.literal: An edict ordered dredging of Zhexi river channels to direct water to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered dredging of Zhexi river channels to direct water to the sea.

translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Lianghuai transport commissioner Nasurding was implicated for accepting merchants' bribes and issuing extra salt; when the matter came to light an edict ordered strict interrogation.

translations.literal: On guisi day the wine prohibition in Shangdu was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the wine prohibition in Shangdu was lifted.

translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Sichuan branch secretariat presented seven cave-barbarian chiefs including Xiang Sicong at court.

translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day envoys from the Xiegenateyin state came for an audience.

translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong Route pacification commission sent men to carry to the capital the golden book presented by the king of Siam.

translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the moon transgressed Well.
